nobunaga.name: 織田信長
nobunaga.character: 威嚴、帶粗獷邊緣的中低男聲；果斷、命令式收尾。
nobunaga.description: A Japanese adult male warlord in his forties. A commanding dry low baritone, speaking in a natural chest range around 120 Hz, slightly rough metallic edge, hard clear consonants and decisive downward endings. Proud, fearless authority. Speak the introduction in a grounded confident low register at normal conversational pitch, with firm support; no high-pitched yelling, strained falsetto or singing.

oichi.name: 阿市
oichi.character: 明亮、有支撐的成熟女聲；戰鬥俐落，勝利帶自信俏皮。
oichi.description: A Japanese adult woman warrior in her late twenties. A bright clear mature feminine upper-register voice with athletic vocal support, ringing clean vowels and lively confident intonation. Energetic and fearless, with a knowing playful smile, never childlike, breathy or whispery. Project strongly as a battlefield warrior, not narration or singing.

hideyoshi.name: 豐臣秀吉
hideyoshi.character: 明亮偏高、稍沙啞的男聲；節奏快速，機靈豪爽。
hideyoshi.description: A Japanese adult male warrior in his thirties. A nimble bright tenor in a natural male range around 200 Hz, slightly nasal brassy resonance and a light raspy bite, quick crisp rhythm and buoyant intonation. Wily, cheerful and boldly energetic, smiling self-confidence. Speak clearly and confidently in a natural adult male register; no squeaky falsetto, high strained shout, singing or child voice.
victories: どうじゃ！わしに任せて正解じゃろ！
よしよし！勝ち鬨を上げい！
まだまだ！天下はこれからじゃ！
victory_subtitles: 還早呢！天下才正要開始！

ieyasu.name: 德川家康
ieyasu.character: 溫厚、厚實的低男中音；沉著、耐心、穩定收尾。
ieyasu.description: A Japanese mature male commander in his fifties. A warm rounded low baritone, full chest resonance without rasp, deliberate measured rhythm and steady calm downward intonation. Patient, grounded and unshakeable, firm powerful support rather than high excited yelling. Project clearly over a battlefield, not quiet narration or singing.
victories: 生き残った。それが何よりだ。
焦ることはない。一歩ずつ進もう。
皆、よく耐えた。勝利は我らにある。
victory_subtitles: 活下來了。這比什麼都重要。
無須焦急。一步一步前進吧。
大家撐得很好。勝利屬於我們。

mitsuhide.name: 明智光秀
mitsuhide.character: 清晰、乾冷的中高男聲；咬字精準、克制而銳利。
mitsuhide.description: A Japanese adult male swordsman in his forties. A cool focused middle tenor around 165 Hz, dry clean narrow resonance, exceptionally precise consonants and clipped controlled phrasing. Intense but restrained, analytical and steely, little playful pitch movement, no gravelly bass rumble or nasal grin. Speak with firm natural male midrange support, not a whisper, excited high shout or singing.
victories: 迷いは捨てた。ただ、進むのみ。
この刃が、道を切り開く。

tadakatsu.name: 本多忠勝
tadakatsu.character: 六人中最深、粗厚的低男聲；短句、爆發力強。
tadakatsu.description: A sixty-five-year-old Japanese man with a very low true bass chest voice. Dark, deep, gravelly and husky. Comfortable relaxed speech around 90 Hz. A calm decisive sentence with flat intonation, thick chest resonance and slow heavy compact consonants. A mature stoic masculine voice, massive protective presence. Speak naturally in the lowest chest range, not shouting, singing, whispering or using high notes.
tadakatsu.intro: 本多忠勝だ。背中は、わしに任せよ。
victories: 守るべき者は、すべて守った。
敵は討った。背は任せよ。
victory_subtitles: 該守護的人，我全都守住了。
